name: Aerial Bunched Cable
summary: An overhead cable assembly with insulated aluminium power cores bundled around a messenger wire for distribution networks.

name: LT XLPE Cable
summary: Low tension power cable with cross-linked polyethylene insulation for distribution installations.

name: PVC Power Cable
summary: Power cable with PVC insulation for low voltage distribution and industrial applications.

name: Control Cable
summary: Multi-core cable for control circuits, instrumentation and automation in industrial installations.

name: Service Cable
summary: Cable for connecting the distribution supply to a customer service point.

name: Covered Conductor for Overhead Lines
summary: Overhead conductor with a protective cover for medium voltage distribution. Contact PCI to confirm construction and rating.

name: All Aluminium Conductor (AAC)
summary: A circular stranded aluminium conductor for overhead power networks.

name: All Aluminium Alloy Conductor (AAAC)
summary: A stranded aluminium magnesium silicon alloy conductor for overhead lines.

name: Aluminium Conductor Steel Reinforced (ACSR)
summary: A stranded aluminium conductor around a steel core for overhead transmission and distribution.

name: Aluminium Alloy Conductor Steel Reinforced (AACSR)
summary: A steel reinforced conductor with stranded aluminium alloy outer wires for overhead power lines.

name: Aluminium Alloy Conductor (AL-59)
summary: An aluminium alloy overhead conductor. Refer to the PCI data sheet for construction and size options.

name: Aluminium Conductor Alloy Reinforced (ACAR)
summary: An aluminium conductor with an aluminium alloy core designed to balance strength, weight and current carrying capacity.

name: ECO Panther Conductor
summary: An overhead conductor with trapezoidal aluminium alloy strands around a round core.

name: Galvanised Steel Earth Wire
summary: Stranded galvanised high carbon steel wire for earthing and shielding on overhead networks.
